sectorSummary.overview: Asset-linked fees, recurring revenue and product diversification support operating growth, while primary-market activity helps selected franchises. Reported profits are more mixed because treasury movements, exceptional charges and expansion costs differ across companies. Regulatory proposals, leverage and delayed profitability remain material qualifications to the sector’s growth outlook.
